stock the shelves: Every morning before the store opens, Tom has to stock the shelves with fresh bread and milk.
每天早上商店開門前，湯姆都得把新鮮的麵包和牛奶上架。
stock up on food: Before the typhoon arrived, many families rushed to the supermarket to stock up on food and water.
颱風來襲前，許多家庭衝去超市囤積食物和水。
be stocked with: The new library will be stocked with thousands of books, so students can borrow almost anything they need.
新圖書館將備有數千本書，所以學生幾乎可以借到任何需要的書。
take stock of: After losing three games in a row, the coach told the team to take stock of their weaknesses.
連輸三場比賽後，教練要球隊評估自己的弱點。
out of stock: Sorry, the new phone you want is out of stock right now, but more will arrive next week.
抱歉，你想要的新手機目前缺貨，不過下週會再到貨。
stock a lake with fish: Every spring, local officials stock a lake with fish so that visitors can enjoy fishing there.
每年春天，地方官員會在湖裡放魚，讓遊客能在那裡享受釣魚的樂趣。
can't stomach violence: My mother can't stomach violence, so she always leaves the room when a fighting scene appears on TV.
我媽媽無法忍受暴力，所以電視上一出現打鬥畫面她就會離開房間。
have no stomach for: After the long and tiring trip, I have no stomach for another argument with my brother tonight.
長途疲累的旅程之後，我今晚實在沒勇氣再和我哥吵一架。
stomach the criticism: New writers must learn to stomach the criticism of readers if they want to keep improving their work.
新作家若想持續改進作品，就必須學會忍受讀者的批評。
turn one's stomach: The smell of the rotten fish in the trash can was so strong that it turned my stomach.
垃圾桶裡腐爛魚的味道強烈到令我作嘔。
stoop to lying: Even when he was in serious trouble, my grandfather would never stoop to lying to his friends.
即使身陷大麻煩，我爺爺也絕不會淪落到對朋友說謊。
stoop so low: I can't believe she would stoop so low as to read her sister's private diary without asking.
我不敢相信她竟會不堪至此，沒問一聲就偷看她妹妹的私人日記。
stoop to their level: When the other players started shouting rude words, our captain told us not to stoop to their level.
當對方球員開始大罵粗話時，我們隊長要我們別自降身價跟他們一般見識。
stoop to pick up: The old man had to stoop to pick up the coins he had dropped on the floor of the bus.
那位老先生得彎腰撿起他掉在公車地板上的硬幣。
storm out of the room: Angry about the unfair decision, Amy stood up and decided to storm out of the room without a word.
艾米對不公平的決定感到憤怒，她站起來一句話也沒說就怒氣沖沖離開房間。
storm the building: The police waited for two hours before they decided to storm the building and rescue the hostages.
警方等了兩個小時後，才決定攻占建築並救出人質。
storm into the office: Furious about his low grade, the student stormed into the office and demanded to see the teacher.
那名學生對自己的低分非常憤怒，衝進辦公室要求見老師。
take by storm: The young singer's first song took the country by storm, and soon everyone was singing it.
那位年輕歌手的第一首歌席捲全國，很快每個人都在唱。
a storm of protest: The government's plan to raise school fees caused a storm of protest from parents and students.
政府調漲學費的計畫引起了家長和學生的一場抗議風暴。
weather the storm: Although the company lost a lot of money last year, it managed to weather the storm and survive.
雖然公司去年虧了很多錢，但它設法度過難關並存活下來。
straighten out a problem: The manager called both workers into a meeting to straighten out a problem that had caused many arguments.
經理把兩名員工叫來開會，解決一個引起許多爭吵的問題。
straighten up one's room: Mom told me to straighten up my room before my friends came over for dinner.
媽媽要我在朋友來吃晚餐前整理房間。
straighten one's priorities: After failing two tests, Jack realized he needed to straighten his priorities and spend less time on games.
考砸兩次後，傑克明白他得理清優先順序，少花點時間打電動。
straighten out one's life: After years of bad habits, he finally decided to quit smoking and straighten out his life.
多年的壞習慣之後，他終於決定戒菸並重整人生。
strain a muscle: If you don't warm up before running, you might strain a muscle and have to rest for weeks.
如果跑步前不暖身，你可能會拉傷肌肉，然後得休息好幾週。
strain relations: The argument over the border could strain relations between the two countries for many years.
邊界的爭議可能使兩國關係緊張很多年。
strain the budget: Buying a new car this year would strain the budget, so our family decided to wait.
今年買新車會使預算吃緊，所以我們家決定再等等。
strain to hear: The music was so loud that I had to strain to hear what my friend was saying.
音樂太大聲了，我得努力聽才聽得到朋友在說什麼。
strain every nerve: The firefighters will strain every nerve to save the children trapped inside the burning house.
消防員們會竭盡全力救出困在失火房屋裡的孩子們。
put a strain on: Working late every night can put a strain on your health and your relationships with family.
每晚加班會對你的健康和家人關係造成壓力。
strain the vegetables: After boiling them for five minutes, strain the vegetables and put them on a plate with some salt.
煮五分鐘後，把蔬菜瀝乾，放在盤子上再撒點鹽。
